slug: 2026-02-20 MICSTI AND NUL ADVANCED LESOTHO DIGITAL PUBLIC INFRASTRUCTURE

facts.fact: A progress review at MICSTI and the National University of Lesotho received a presentation of X-Road as a system to connect government ministries and enable electronic information sharing, among systems that 'will modernize' services; no service date or connected bodies are given.

note: MoU names enhanced information exchange across ministries as a priority for the year; no platform is named, procured or built.

facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT (MICSTI) with UNICEF Lesotho held a workshop on 20-23 October 2026 in Berea to plan an X-Road pilot, assess ministries' readiness to join the National Data Exchange and set an implementation roadmap.

note: Names IEC-NICR data-sharing but no exchange platform.
Planned X-Road already held; link is a government home page.

facts.fact: UCL IIPP's DPI Map lists Lesotho's data exchange system as Implemented (fully operational and in use), citing an AfDB e-government infrastructure completion report, as checked on 2024-10-01; the date is the check date, the line gives no other.
